name: Muhammad Ishaq Khan
tagline: Code running in VS Code and Flutter. Building AI-powered dev tools, secure systems, and production apps at ELTE.
about: I'm a final-year Computer Science student at Eötvös Loránd University (ELTE) in Budapest, building backbencher.cc — an AST-native code intelligence platform that indexes codebases into a queryable knowledge graph with 13 brain tools.

I've contributed to VS Code (performance optimization) and Flutter (security hardening), and built ProxiCall — a production Flutter super-app with Stripe payments, geo-fencing, and 32-language translation. My BSc thesis on ML-based phishing detection achieved 96.45% accuracy.

mobile: Firebase SDK (Auth, Firestore, Storage, Functions, Messaging)

projects.name: backbencher.cc (bb)
projects.description: My primary project — an open-core AST-native code intelligence platform that indexes entire codebases into a local SQLite knowledge graph. Ships with 13 brain tools for semantic search, call-graph traversal, AST-precise refactoring, architectural pattern detection, cross-language migration, and security scanning across 38 languages.
highlights: 13 brain tools (bb_search, bb_select, bb_refactor, bb_security, bb_migrate, bb_relationships, bb_patterns, bb_visualize, bb_ask, bb_update, bb_insert, bb_delete)
Offline semantic search with word vectors
Beats Copilot on compiler-level code reasoning — benchmarked against TypeScript (VS Code) and Roslyn codebases

experience.description: Building an open-core AST-native code intelligence platform. Indexes codebases into a queryable SQLite knowledge graph with 13 brain tools for semantic search, call-graph traversal, AST-precise refactoring, and security scanning across 39 languages.

Developing a production Flutter proximity super-app with Stripe Connect payments, geo-fencing, 32-language auto-translation, and geo-targeted notifications with AI segmentation. Built 5 integrated systems: CMS, PMS, OMS, NMS, and ENS.

Hands-on training in privacy-preserving technologies and OSINT. Worked with secure operating systems, anonymous communication tools, PGP encryption, and advanced information gathering techniques including Shodan and social media reconnaissance.
Practical training in wireless network penetration testing and vulnerability assessment. Gained proficiency with industry-standard tools for network reconnaissance, packet analysis, and exploitation.

Remote internship during COVID-19 focused on offensive security. Learned payload generation, Android APK reverse engineering, web application attacks including XSS, and post-exploitation techniques with Metasploit.
